summary: ATS Corporation filed a Form 6-K furnishing a press release dated October 21, 2026, announcing it will report second-quarter fiscal 2026 results for the period ended September 27, 2026, before markets open on November 4, 2026, followed by an 8:30 a.m. Eastern conference call and webcast with management remarks and analyst Q&A. No transaction, stake, price, premium, board recommendation, advisor, or structural mechanics are disclosed. The filing is a routine earnings-scheduling notice, equivalent to a US Form 8-K investor-relations announcement; no deal terms and no risk-arb angle apply.
